description: This file defines a Spring configuration class for generating a secret key used in JWT token signing, utilizing a configuration property to obtain the secret key string.

classes.name: JwtSecretKey
classes.description: A Spring configuration class that provides a bean for the JWT secret key, constructed from a secret string obtained via dependency injection.

methods.description: Constructor that injects the JwtConfig dependency.

methods.name: secretKey
methods.description: Creates and exposes a SecretKey bean initialized with the secret key configured.
